simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to אַקּוֹ (H689) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.

simple.summary: אַקּוֹ (ʼaqqôw) means slender , i.e. the ibex First listed occurrence: Deut 14 5.

definitions.full: H689. aqqo אַקּוֺ noun masculine wild goat (?) only Deut 14:5 in list of clean animals וּתְאוֺ וְדִישׁוֺן וְאַקּוֺ וְיַחְמוּר וּצְבִי אַיָּל וָזָ֑מֶר ( ᵐ5 ὄρυξ , ᵑ7 ᵑ6 ibex ; compare Bo Hieroz. i. 900 f. , Thes below אנק compare MV, with reference to Arabic goat ; Thes compare also Talmud אִיקָא , but NHWB MV refer this to αἴξ ). אֹר see אוֺר , for Amos Deut 8:8 see יְאֹר .
